name: Double Buffer Shared Warp Marching
definition: A pipeline manner reduction approach (double buffer color blending) to mitigate the active thread reduction issue in SBShared. The warp delays blending until all threads have received enough data.
summary: Double Buffer Shared Warp Marching is a warp-level volume rendering technique that maintains full warp activity during reduction by using two shared memory buffers per thread to delay color blending.
